text:
Items in the first photo: 2 slices of toast, 2 fried eggs, an English muffin with ham (a sandwich), and a glass of orange juice.

Estimated energy:
- Toast, 2 slices: about 26 g each, so 52 g and roughly 140 kcal. Butter doesn't appear to be on it.
- Fried eggs, 2: about 92 g and roughly 180 kcal.
- English muffin sandwich: muffin about 60 g (~130 kcal) plus ham about 40 g (~50 kcal), so about 100 g and 180 kcal.
- Orange juice: about 250 ml, so about 250 g and roughly 110 kcal.

Total offered is about 494 g and 610 kcal.

In the second photo everything is gone except egg yolk residue on the plate and a trace of juice in the glass. I'll count about 95% as eaten, which gives about 580 kcal and about 470 g.
